known_secrets.text: I have seen older stone edges beneath irrigation channels that do not match modern farming layouts.
Kiri once showed me a path in the forest that leads uphill toward the monument terraces.
That path feels 'older' than the farm system.
I once overheard Mara talking about hidden food reserves.
She stopped speaking when she noticed me.
Ikan once told me he thinks the monument has 'closed doors that were meant to open.'
I do not know what he meant, but I remember it.
Sena keeps notebooks of stories people tell her.
She said no two people remember the same past.
